rejected_candidates.reason: Already a finite active low-spin catch; another recovery/rescue branch risks hiding failure and duplicating Sink.

Freshly accepted hard-hit follow-up already has a distinct immediate/delayed purpose; preserve it.

ecology_findings: Few deeper families cover distinct roles without changing the sixteen-base acquisition pool.
Crash Guard baseline activation is accepted opposing severity, not guaranteed directional reception; guard starts after the triggering hit.
Momentum Bank captures genuine braking loss outside Orbit drift, so simultaneous drift and banking cannot be described as a free combo.
Effective defence masses may stack, but input/position/movement gates conflict and stored force must be based on actual accepted remaining recoil.
Reactive Plating overlaps Sink/Counterweight conceptually; next distinct aimed single-hit use, short expiry, no Brake vent or RPM return make the selected contract distinct.
Perpetual Orbit overlaps Flow State efficiency; real same-sign full DRIVE and costly correction keep it a technique choice, not general passive drain tuning.
Centrifuge overlaps Crosscut tangent geometry; spending full fresh earned DRIVE and losing sustain makes it a resource/route decision.
No source-only universal best-pick claim or automatic nerf is justified for Clutch, Dead Centre, Impact Sink or Orbit Drive.
Rank III must change control/geometry/timing decisions rather than only increase a numeric factor.
Accepted neutral standalone Host compatibility is restored by pure catalogue/rank validation and early neutral gates; no extra Host Battle fields or I/II recipes were introduced.
